title: Melanoma, Breslow 1.2 mm
notice: Synthetic and AI-written. Needs review by a pathologist before being used to score anything (issue #22).

keys.span: a cancer of the pigment-making cells in the skin
keys.correct: Melanoma is a cancer of melanocytes, the pigment-producing cells of the skin.
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: The Breslow thickness was 1.2 millimeters, which is how wide the spot was.
keys.issue: Breslow thickness is depth, not width.
keys.correct: Breslow thickness is how deep the melanoma grew into the skin, measured in millimeters. It is the main factor in the T stage.
keys.source_hint: CAP cutaneous melanoma protocol; AJCC 8th melanoma
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: Next we'll remove a wider area of skin around the scar.
keys.issue: Misses lymph node evaluation and the margin size.
keys.correct: For a melanoma thicker than 0.8 mm a sentinel lymph node biopsy is usually discussed. Wide excision margins are typically 1 to 2 cm for this thickness.
keys.speaker: doctor
